name: Maryland 4-H Youth Development
city: Statewide, Maryland (a local Extension office in each county); state center in College Park
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club or program. It has hands-on projects, camps and STEM contests. It also has animal and environmental science, leadership and community service.
who_can_apply: The Maryland 4-H pages read do not list an age range. Programs vary by county. Contact your local Extension office to learn which clubs and programs fit your age.
pay_detail: The page says costs are kept to a minimum. No amounts are given.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs, camps and events set their own dates.
how_to_apply: Contact your local University of Maryland Extension office. Ask about clubs, camps and programs in your county. Then use the Enroll in Maryland 4-H link on the Join a Club page.
notes: Maryland 4-H Center: 8020 Greenmead Drive, College Park, MD 20740, 301-314-9070. The leadership page lists a 2026 Volunteer and Teen Forum in Ocean City in November 2026. It has workshops for adults and teens aged 13 and older.
